oauth.scope.moderator.manage.chat.body: Delete messages, ban and time out people, and change chat modes in channels you moderate.

oauth.scope.channel.read.tips.title: See your tips
oauth.scope.channel.read.tips.body: See the tips your channel receives.
oauth.scope.channel.manage.polls.title: Run polls
oauth.scope.channel.manage.polls.body: Start and end polls on your channel.
oauth.scope.channel.manage.predictions.b: Start, lock, settle and cancel predictions on your channel.
oauth.scope.channel.manage.raids.title: Raid other channels
oauth.scope.channel.manage.raids.body: Start and cancel raids from your channel.
oauth.scope.channel.manage.bot.title: Manage your channel bot

oauth.scope.channel.manage.points.title: Give and take channel points

oauth.scope.user.read.follows.title: See who you follow

oauth.scope.user.manage.follows.title: Follow channels for you

oauth.scope.clips.edit.title: Make clips
oauth.scope.sensitiveHint: This permission reaches private data or acts with real weight. Grant it only to apps you trust.
oauth.consent.heading: {app} wants to use your account
oauth.consent.notSee: It will not be able to see your password, or your email address unless it is listed above.
oauth.consent.afterwards: You can disconnect this app at any time in Settings, Connections.
oauth.consent.decideFailed: The app could not be authorized. Try again in a moment.
oauth.consent.decideSuspended: This app was suspended while you were deciding, so it cannot be authorized.
oauth.consent.decideInvalid: This request is no longer valid. Go back to the app and start again.
oauth.error.title: This request cannot be completed
oauth.error.invalidClient: The app that sent you here is not registered on this site. Check the link, or ask the app's developer.
oauth.error.invalidRedirectUri: The app asked to send you to an address it did not register. For your safety, you were not sent back.
oauth.error.appSuspended: This app is suspended and cannot be authorized right now.
oauth.error.failed: The request could not be checked. Try again in a moment.
oauth.device.intro: Enter the code your device or bot shows to let it use your account.
oauth.device.codeHint: Eight letters, for example BCDF-GHJK. The dash is optional.
oauth.device.codeInvalid: Enter the eight letters your device shows.
oauth.device.lookupFailed: The code could not be checked. Try again in a moment.
oauth.device.notFound: That code is not valid. Check it against your device and try again.
oauth.device.expired: That code expired or was already used. Ask your device for a new one.
oauth.device.suspended: The app behind that code is suspended and cannot be connected.
oauth.device.decideFailed: Your answer could not be saved. Try again in a moment.
oauth.device.approvedBody: Return to your device. It will finish signing in by itself.
oauth.device.deniedBody: The device was refused and cannot use your account.
oauth.connections.intro: Apps and bots you have allowed to use your account.
oauth.connections.loadFailed: Your connections could not be loaded.
oauth.connections.emptyHint: When you authorize an app or a bot, it shows up here and you can disconnect it.
oauth.connections.revokeBody: {app} loses access to your account at once. Its chat bots are disconnected and its event subscriptions stop. To use it again you must authorize it again.
oauth.connections.revokeFailed: The app could not be disconnected. Try again.
